mechanism: Generate supporting and opposing diagnostic criteria from sorted candidate names before applying them to current case; compare same generation with current case visible.
sharing: Exact same candidate set shares names-only request/output within one original backbone. Candidate set still depends on patient via frozen front end; no claim of full data independence.
controls: Same1 knowledge-generation+4 cyclic-order final scores per instance, except names-only cache reuse. Same schemas, output limits, final original contexts and decision policy. Reuse original uncued4 and calibrated49.
inference: Original weights and own native context. Generated knowledge is marked as fallible general knowledge, not patient observations. No new retrieval or training labels.
scope: Same40 exposed R3 diagnosis cases per M4/M5. Fixed candidate pool, no exclusion for missing gold. Invalid knowledge returns actual initial calibrated answer.
adaptation: CFDX4.1–4.5 candidate evidence motivation, StepBack2 principles-before-application, CoVe3.3 context separation. No full method reproduction or clinical-rule validation.
criterion: Cross-backbone net benefit versus case-visible knowledge and current calibrated head before expansion; report repair/harm and common-valid subset; no posthoc per-disease gates.
